comment: Searches the team-tilemap remap list for an entry containing the given tile ID and returns the tile ID for the requested team color (slot 1 or 2, otherwise neutral), or the original ID if no entry matches.

name: TeamTilemap_RemapShapeFaces
comment: Iterates over every face of a shape, looks each face's tile ID up in the team-tilemap remap list, and writes back the team-colored tile ID (slot 1 or 2, otherwise neutral) into the shape's per-face tile array.

name: TeamTilemap_BuildRemapTable
comment: Populates the team-tilemap remap list by registering all known structure/vehicle texture names paired with their team-colored variants.

name: TerrainVtx_InitPackedRecord
comment: Initializes a packed terrain-vertex record, setting its two 9-bit index fields to 0x1ff and clearing the remaining fields.

name: TerrainVtx_ResetEdgeRecord
comment: Fills a 16-byte terrain edge/neighbor record with 0xffff sentinel values to mark it as empty.

name: TerrainVtx_CompareByHeight
comment: qsort comparator that decodes the height of two packed terrain vertices (via the active patch node's height table and scale/bias) and returns -1/0/1 ordering them by decoded height.

name: TerrainPatch_BuildSortedHeightIndex
comment: Builds the patch node's 0x121-entry vertex index array (packing each vertex height into the high bits), sorts it by height with TerrainVtx_CompareByHeight, and resets the node's index iteration cursor and count.

name: Bit_MaskToIndex
comment: Maps a single-bit mask (1,2,4,...,0x40) to its 0-based bit index 0..6, returning -1 for any other value.

name: TerrainVtx_ComputeHeightError
comment: Returns the absolute height error of a packed terrain vertex versus the midpoint of its two edge neighbors (zero if both neighbor indices are the empty 0x1ff sentinel), used to drive patch LOD detail.

name: Terrain_BuildPatchNode
comment: Builds one terrain quadtree patch node: scans its 17x17 (0x121) vertex block for min/max height and brightness, packs height and lighting indices into each vertex word, and computes the node's bounding-box center, extents, and bounding-sphere radius.

name: Terrain_RebuildTreeRecursive
comment: Recursively rebuilds every node of the terrain quadtree, calling Terrain_BuildPatchNode on the current node and descending into its three child subtrees plus its sibling chain until a leaf (node+0x754==1) is reached.

name: Terrain_RebuildTreeInRectRecursive
comment: Recursively rebuilds only the terrain quadtree nodes whose bounds (node+0x744/0x748/0x74c/0x750) overlap the given grid rectangle, calling Terrain_BuildPatchNode on each visited node and descending into its children and sibling chain.
prototype: undefined __cdecl Terrain_RebuildTreeInRectRecursive(int * treeRoot, int node, int rectMinX, int rectMinY, int rectMaxX, int rectMaxY)

name: Terrain_AllocLevelGrid
comment: Allocates a grid of terrain quadtree patch nodes (0x790 bytes each) sized to the heightmap divided by the given patch stride, constructs each node, fills in its grid extents/stride fields, and returns the node array while writing the column count to *param_3.
prototype: uint * __cdecl Terrain_AllocLevelGrid(uint * param_1, uint patchStride, int * outColumns, undefined1 initFlag)

name: Terrain_LinkChildNodes
comment: Links each parent node of one quadtree level to its four child nodes in the finer level below and writes the parent back-pointer (+0x768) into all four children.
prototype: undefined __fastcall Terrain_LinkChildNodes(undefined4 param_1, int childLevel, int parentLevel, int numColumns)

name: Terrain_ComputeTriNormalEven
comment: Computes the (unnormalized) face normal of the first-orientation triangle of a terrain grid cell via the cross product of its two edge vectors, writing the xyz result through the in_EAX output pointer.

name: Terrain_ComputeTriNormalOdd
comment: Computes the (unnormalized) face normal of the second-orientation triangle of a terrain grid cell via the cross product of its two edge vectors, writing the xyz result through the in_EAX output pointer.

name: Terrain_ShadeVertexToPalette
comment: Computes a terrain vertex's shading by averaging its surrounding triangle normals and dotting with the sun direction plus a Laplacian curvature/ambient-occlusion term, maps the result to a palette index, and packs that index into the vertex word.

name: Terrain_UpdateRowHeightBounds
comment: Scans the heights over a rectangular block of terrain vertices to find their min and max, updates the active node's stored low/high bounds (node+0x1c/+0x28), and dispatches either a rect-limited or full quadtree rebuild depending on whether the bounds changed.
prototype: undefined __cdecl Terrain_UpdateRowHeightBounds(int rowStart, int colEnd, int rowEnd)

name: Terrain_BuildQuadtree
comment: Allocates and builds the full terrain LOD quadtree from a heightmap, generating successively coarser node-grid levels (doubling the patch stride each pass) via Terrain_AllocLevelGrid and linking each finer level to its parent with Terrain_LinkChildNodes until a single root remains.

name: Mesh_EncodeNeighborIndex
comment: Clamps the two input coordinates into the 0..0x10 (17x17) grid, computing the linear index row*0x11+col, and returns either the plain index or, if either axis overflowed the grid edge, a negated value packing the wrap-direction quadrant bits (0x800/0x200) with the index.

name: Mesh_BuildSubdivisionTree
comment: Recursively subdivides the 17x17 terrain mesh, writing the subdivision level and four encoded neighbor/child edge indices into each node record (in the _DAT_005e6a00 and DAT_005e70c8 node arrays), setting child-present flag bits, and recursing into the four sub-triangles.
prototype: undefined __cdecl Mesh_BuildSubdivisionTree(undefined4 param_1, uint level, int stride, int param_4, int param_5)

name: Mesh_DecodeNodeEdgeIndices
comment: Decodes a mesh node's two packed edge codes back into grid row/column coordinates (div/mod 0x11) and writes the two reconstructed vertex indices into the caller-supplied short[2] output buffer.

name: Mesh_InitTerrainLODTables
comment: Allocates and constructs the terrain LOD node arrays (DAT_005e70c8 and _DAT_005e6a00), builds the recursive subdivision tree and the two triangle binary trees, fills the per-node and coordinate-encoding lookup tables, and builds the renderer projection-step and sample lookup tables.

name: Mesh_BuildTriangleBinTree
comment: Recursively builds one triangle of the ROAM-style triangle binary tree by computing the min/max grid coordinates of its three corners, classifying its orientation, storing corners/midpoint into a freshly allocated 0x28-byte node record (array DAT_005f61a0, index counter DAT_006784ec), and recursing into its two child triangles; returns the node index.
prototype: int __cdecl Mesh_BuildTriangleBinTree(uint level, int cornerA, int cornerApex, int cornerB, undefined4 parentIndex)

name: MapTileBucket_Init
comment: Initializes a map tile-bucket object by zeroing its bucket-list head and the associated counter/state fields at offsets 0x734 through 0x78c.

name: MapTileBucket_RecycleAll
comment: Drains a map tile object's bucket list by repeatedly calling MapTileBucket_Recycle until the list head at offset 0x738 is empty.

name: Map_FreeTileRowArrays
comment: Iterates the map's array of tile-row pointers (at offset 0x1c, count at 0x6c) and, for each non-null row, runs the array destructor (0x790-byte elements, destructor MapTileBucket_RecycleAll) and frees the backing allocation.

name: Map_Destroy
comment: Destroys a map object by releasing its four texture/resource handles at offsets 0xc-0x18 (resetting each to -1), freeing all tile-row arrays via Map_FreeTileRowArrays, and freeing the object itself.

name: Client_MainGameLoop
comment: Runs the client's main game loop: plays the startup sound, then forever measures the per-frame time delta (clamped to 500ms), services networking, interpolates entities, updates particle/HUD/FX systems, and polls and processes input each tick.

name: Markup_ResetWidgetLists
comment: Frees and tears down the widget's child, string, and attribute lists then allocates fresh empty list containers for the latter two.

name: Widget_SetFlagOn
comment: Sets the widget's byte flag at offset 0x28 to 1 (enabled/true).

name: Widget_SetFlagOff
comment: Clears the widget's byte flag at offset 0x28 to 0 (disabled/false).

name: Widget_SetBoundsRect
comment: Stores the widget's left/top and computed right/bottom screen-rect edges then forwards x/y/width/height to the layout-update helper.
prototype: undefined __thiscall Widget_SetBoundsRect(int x, int y, int width, int height)

name: Widget_FreeChildList
comment: Walks the widget's child-widget list, unlinking each node, destroying the child via its cleanup helper, and freeing it.

name: Markup_ParseSoundAttributes
comment: Reads three string markup attributes and stores duplicated copies into the active widget struct fields 0x5c, 0x60, and 0x64, freeing any prior values.

name: Markup_AppendStringAttribute
comment: Reads a markup attribute, allocates a one-pointer node holding a duplicated copy (or null), and appends it to the widget's string list at offset 0x38.

name: PadChunk_Init
comment: Constructs a Pad_Chunk widget, copying the layout's tex handle, setting default fields and vtable, then applying its initial bounds rect.
prototype: undefined4 * __stdcall PadChunk_Init(undefined4 * self, int layout, int width)

name: Chunk_Init
comment: Initializes a Chunk widget, copying parent layout texture/flag/color fields, setting its vtable and default state, and linking it to its parent.

name: Chunk_SetText
comment: Replaces the chunk's stored text by duplicating the given string into a freshly allocated buffer, recording its length, and invoking the vtable layout callback sized by the per-character width.

name: Markup_DrawGlyphRunScaled
comment: Draws one text run/glyph: looks up its palette color, optionally selects its font texture, then issues the device draw call either scaled (with the given scale factor) or unscaled.
prototype: undefined __fastcall Markup_DrawGlyphRunScaled(undefined4 param_1, undefined4 param_2, undefined4 param_3)

name: Markup_RunChunk_DrawUnitScale
comment: Virtual draw method for a text-run chunk that renders its run handle (this+0x30/0x34) at unit (1.0) scale via Markup_DrawGlyphRunScaled.

name: Markup_RunChunk_DrawScaled
comment: Virtual draw method for a text-run chunk that renders its run at the caller-supplied scale factor via Markup_DrawGlyphRunScaled.
prototype: undefined __stdcall Markup_RunChunk_DrawScaled(undefined1 param_1, undefined4 param_2, undefined4 param_3, undefined4 param_4)

name: Markup_LinkChunk_HandleEvent
comment: Virtual event handler for a link/hot chunk: on a left-click (event type 1, code 5) it resolves the chunk's link index into the document's chunk array and stores the found target as the document's active link.

name: Markup_ResetLineState
comment: Resets the current layout line by computing the remaining line width (content width divided by the font space advance) and allocating a fresh empty word list for the line.

name: Markup_FlushLine
comment: Finalizes the current word list into a laid-out line: measures each word's width/height, inserts left/right padding chunks for center/right alignment when needed, appends the line (with its max height) to the document line list, and resets line state.

name: Markup_EmitWordsWithWrap
comment: Word-wraps the pending text against the line's remaining width by breaking at the last space that fits, appends each fitted word run to the current line, flushes the line when the width is exhausted, and repeats for the rest of the text.

name: Markup_FlushPendingText
comment: Takes the accumulated text from the global working buffer, trims trailing spaces (unless inside a preformatted span), passes it to Markup_EmitWordsWithWrap for layout, and frees the buffer copy.

name: Markup_BuildDocument
comment: Main markup layout driver: walks the parsed markup node list and dispatches each tag opcode (font/color, alignment, link, embedded element, paragraph/line breaks, list indent) to build the laid-out line list for the document.

name: Markup_HitTestAndDispatchClick
comment: Hit-tests a point against the laid-out document: scrolls to the visible line for the given Y, walks each line's run chunks to find the one whose bounding box contains the point, and invokes that chunk's click/activate handler.

name: Markup_ComputePreferredSize
comment: Walks the document's row list to sum total content height and find the widest row, then invokes the supplied callback with the computed maximum width and total height.

name: Markup_MeasureRowHeights
comment: If the document is already built, measures each widget in every row and stores the tallest widget height as that row's height; otherwise rebuilds the widget lists from the markup first.

name: Markup_GetTotalHeight
comment: Sums the heights of all rows in the document's row list, writing zero to the optional width output and the accumulated total to the optional height output.

name: Markup_RenderDocument
comment: Computes the scrollbar position from total content height, clamps the track window, then draws each visible row's widgets left to right within the clip rectangle, advancing the x cursor by each widget's measured width.

name: DocumentViewer_Construct
comment: Constructs a Document_Viewer object: installs its vftable, initializes scroll/layout fields and rectangle, allocates the Glowy chunk generator and the markup parser, and resets the widget lists to an empty document.

name: DocumentViewer_Destruct
comment: Destroys a Document_Viewer object: resets the widget lists, frees the parsed document and the row/column/widget list heads, destroys the embedded parser objects, and chains to the base destructor.

name: ChunkGenerator_Construct
comment: Installs the Chunk_Generator vftable into the object, constructing the base chunk-generator instance.

name: ChunkGenerator_ProduceChunk
comment: Allocates a new 0x44-byte chunk and, on success, builds it from the generator's source object, releasing the passed-in argument before returning the new chunk.

name: ChunkStats_IncrementBucket
comment: Lazily allocates a per-object stats node from the global free list, then increments its total count and the per-level bucket counter for the given level index.

name: ChunkStats_DecrementBucket
comment: Decrements the per-level bucket counter and total count on the object's stats node, releasing the node back to the global free list when the total reaches zero.

name: Tex_ExpireScheduledList
comment: Walks the object's scheduled list, unlinking every node whose threshold is at or below the current counter, invoking each one's callback and returning its block back to the free pool while updating the pool's used count and lists.

name: Tex_AllocPixelsForLevel
comment: Allocates the texture's pixel block from the texture cache, sets its width/height to 1<<level, initializes the mip-level count and edge/wrap bytes, and records the owner pointer plus the current cache generation.

name: Tex_FillGlowMipAlpha
comment: Fills one mip level of a radial glow texture with 8-bit alpha values, computing each pixel from its distance to the center with a falloff curve and writing 0 outside the radius.

name: Tex_BuildGlowAlphaTexture
comment: Allocates a new texture slot and its pixel block, clears it, then fills every mip level (0..param_1) with the procedural 8-bit alpha glow pattern and returns the new texture id.

name: Tex_FillGlowMipRgba
comment: Fills one mip level of a radial glow texture with 32-bit RGBA pixels, writing the same distance-based falloff intensity into all four channels of each texel.

name: Tex_BuildGlowRgbaTexture
comment: Allocates a new texture slot and its pixel block in the 4-channel RGBA format, clears it, then fills every mip level (0..param_1) with the procedural glow pattern and returns the new texture id.

name: Tex_AllocSlot
comment: Pops the next free texture-slot id, pulls a texture object from the block pool (allocating a new block if empty), zeroes all of its fields, sets the default state/flags, stores it in the slot table and returns the object.

name: Tex_InitObjectPool
comment: Allocates and initializes the global block allocator (40-byte items, 10 per block) used to hand out texture objects, storing it in the global pool pointer or null on out-of-memory.

name: Tex_InitNameEntry
comment: Constructs a texture name-table entry by zeroing its first two bytes; used as the per-element constructor by the vector constructor iterator.

name: Tex_FindByName
comment: Looks up the given name in the texture name-to-id hash map and returns the stored id, or 0 if the name is absent or maps to the sentinel -1.

name: TexCache_LoadTileOrFail
comment: Loads a named tile via the global tile loader, and on failure logs "Unable to load tile '%s'!", shows a fatal reinstall dialog, and returns -1.

name: TexCache_AppendTextureToCategory
comment: Grows the indexed texture-category's int array by one entry, copies the old contents, appends the given texture id, and updates the array pointer and count.

name: TexCache_RemoveTextureFromCategory
comment: Rebuilds the indexed texture-category's int array omitting every entry equal to the given texture id, freeing the old array and updating the pointer and count.

name: TexCache_LoadCategoryModel
comment: Loads the named model file (falling back to a "_skinny" variant) into the current texture category, populates its texture list, and warns "can't find normal or skinny for <%s>" if neither loads.

name: TexCache_LockUnlockCategory
comment: Parses a "lock"/"unlock" command and a category name, then for the matching texture category either allocates and uploads each texture's chunk into the texture cache (lock) or decrements its reference counts and frees freelist blocks when they reach zero (unlock).

name: TexCache_Init
comment: Initializes the texture cache: allocates the loader and the 5-entry texture-category array, zeroes the 32000-slot chunk table and id free-list, and builds the reserved placeholder chunk.

name: TexCache_LoadCategoryBitmaps
comment: Builds the "bitmaps\\<categoryName>" path for the given texture category and loads that model/bitmap group into the cache.

name: TexCache_CreateChunkFromBitmap
comment: Allocates a new texture chunk id, fills a chunk for the given indexed bitmap (uploading it into a cache block and building mipmaps when the dimensions match a power-of-two level, otherwise keeping a malloc'd copy), registers it, and returns the chunk id.
prototype: uint __cdecl TexCache_CreateChunkFromBitmap(int height, void * pixels, char * name, char wantMipmap, char transparent)

name: TexCache_AllocChunk
comment: Allocates a new texture chunk and initializes its width, height, format/type, duplicated name string, and flag byte.
prototype: int __cdecl TexCache_AllocChunk(undefined4 format, undefined2 width, undefined2 height, char * name, undefined1 flagByte)

name: TexCache_ReadChunkFromFile
comment: Seeks to the given file offset, reads a 3- or 9-byte texture header to determine format and dimensions, allocates a chunk, reads its pixel data from the file, registers it in the chunk table, and returns the chunk (or null on read failure).
prototype: undefined4 * __thiscall TexCache_ReadChunkFromFile(undefined1 param_1, char * name, int fileOffset)

name: Tgen_LoadBitmapPackEntries
comment: Allocates a pointer array, loads every bitmap entry of the open pack via Tex_LoadBitmapFromFile, registers each loaded texture name in the global hash table, and returns the array and its count.
prototype: undefined __cdecl Tgen_LoadBitmapPackEntries(void * packObj, undefined1 param_2, undefined4 * outArray, uint * outCount)

name: Tex_SerializeToStream
comment: Writes a texture entry's header byte and dimensions to the output stream and appends its pixel rows, handling the format-3 cutout case (re-reading from disk when the mip level differs).

name: Tgen_BuildAndWriteBitmapPack
comment: Builds the "c:\\ntank\\data\\bitmaps\\new\\<name>" path, serializes every texture of that pack slot into a memory stream while recording per-entry offsets, and writes the resulting bitmap pack file to disk.

name: Tgen_BuildAllBitmapPacks
comment: Iterates over all bitmap pack descriptor slots and calls Tgen_BuildAndWriteBitmapPack for each named/eligible slot, returning false on the first failure or true when all slots are processed.

name: Tex_FreeEntry
comment: Releases a texture handle: invokes its destructor callback, unlinks it from the texture cache, frees its pixel memory, clears the slot in the handle table, and returns the texture id to the free-id stack.

name: Tex_ReserveScratchSpace
comment: Reserves an 8-byte-aligned chunk in the texture manager's scratch buffer, growing the buffer if the requested size exceeds the remaining room, and advances the buffer's used/free counters.

name: Tex_GetOrCreateCutout
comment: Returns the texture id of a cached "__cutout" sub-texture matching the source texture and rectangle, allocating a new power-of-two cutout entry and copying the sub-rectangle of pixels when no cached match exists.
prototype: uint __stdcall Tex_GetOrCreateCutout(int * srcTex, int rectX, int rectY, void * logSize)

name: Tgen_InitDiskGenerator
comment: Initializes the disk texture-generator module by installing the Tgen_Disk vtable and constructing its three bookkeeping list structures.

name: Tgen_ShutdownDiskGenerator
comment: Tears down the disk texture-generator module by destroying its three bookkeeping list structures in reverse order.

name: TexCache_InsertOrReplaceBlock
comment: Searches the texture cache's block lists for a slot matching the given block, replacing or merging an existing block (freeing it and adjusting free-space totals) or appending the new block, and unlinks the old cache region.

name: TexCache_ServiceLoadRequest
comment: Services one pending texture LOD request by reusing a cached block, reading the block from file and inserting it into the active list while charging the memory budget, or requeuing it when the budget is exhausted.

name: TexCache_EnqueueBlockLoad
comment: Allocates a 0x18-byte texture-load request node, fills in its block handle, format, source descriptor and byte size, marks the source's pending-LOD field, and immediately tries to service it.

name: TexCache_PumpQueues
comment: Per-frame texture-cache pump that completes finished async reads, uploads loaded texels into their block descriptors, frees the request nodes, then services queued load requests until the memory budget is reached and resets the budget.

name: TexCache_ReadBlockFromFile
comment: Allocates a buffer sized for the block's LOD level, seeks to the block's file offset, reads its texel data via fread, and returns the buffer pointer and byte size.
prototype: undefined4 __stdcall TexCache_ReadBlockFromFile(int block, undefined4 * outBuf, size_t * outSize)

name: TexCache_FlushQueues
comment: Discards all pending and in-flight texture-load requests, restoring each affected block's current-LOD field, unlinking its cache block, and clearing both request lists.

name: TexCache_InitStreamManager
comment: Allocates and constructs the global texture-streaming/async-IO manager object and initializes the cache's per-frame memory budget.

name: ProcTex_BuildEscapeBandTables
comment: Precomputes the 16 squared-radius escape thresholds and matching palette color indices used by the procedural escape-iteration texture generator.

name: ProcTex_FillEscapeIterationTile
comment: Fills a size x size pixel tile by running a Mandelbrot-style escape iteration per texel and mapping the final squared magnitude to a palette index via the precomputed band tables.
prototype: undefined __fastcall ProcTex_FillEscapeIterationTile(undefined4 param_1, char * pixelOut, int size)

name: ProcTex_GenerateBlockLod
comment: Regenerates a texture block at the given LOD by unlinking the old cache block, allocating a new one, filling it with the procedural escape-iteration pattern, building its mip chain, and updating the block's LOD bookkeeping fields.

name: ProcTex_BuildEscapeBandTables
comment: \N

name: ProcTex_ComputeFalloffColor
comment: Computes a scaled palette color byte from a distance-based quadratic falloff, returning zero when the sample lies beyond the near threshold.
prototype: undefined4 __cdecl ProcTex_ComputeFalloffColor(float intensity, float farDist, float sampleDist)

name: Lightmap_ComputeTileMonoIntensity
comment: Computes a single-channel light intensity for each vertex of a terrain tile grid by summing distance-attenuated particle-light contributions onto the base ambient value, clamps to 0..0x7f0000, and stores them in the mono lightmap scratch table at DAT_0062f040.

name: Lightmap_CreateTileBlock
comment: Allocates a new texture-block descriptor, configures it as a "pre_lightmap" RGB565 texture sized for the tile's detail level, and registers it in the tile-handle table (DAT_00630280) returning the new block handle.

name: Lightmap_ComputeTileRgbIntensity
comment: Computes per-vertex red/green/blue light intensities for a terrain tile grid by summing distance-attenuated particle-light contributions, applies gamma scaling, and stores the float RGB triplets in the color lightmap scratch table at DAT_0062f4d8.

name: Lightmap_BuildTileRgbTexture
comment: Builds the colored RGB565 lightmap texels for a tile by computing per-vertex RGB intensities, clamping each channel, and packing the rounded values into the tile block's texel buffer.

name: Lightmap_BuildTileMonoTexture
comment: Builds the grayscale RGB565 lightmap texels for a tile by computing per-vertex mono intensities, clamping, and packing the single value replicated across all three channels into the tile block's texel buffer.

name: Lightmap_AddInterpolatedGradientRow
comment: Additively blends a bilinearly-interpolated light gradient (from the lightmap scratch table corners) onto one block of texel rows, advancing the interpolants by fixed-point steps scaled by the mip shift.
prototype: undefined __fastcall Lightmap_AddInterpolatedGradientRow(undefined4 param_1, int tileRow, int mipShift, int destRow, int destStride, int tileCol)

name: Lightmap_ComposeShadedMips
comment: Composites the tile's source texture blocks into the lightmap texel buffer at the selected mip level, modulating each texel by the per-vertex light intensity (and at coarser mips upscaling via the gradient blend in Lightmap_AddInterpolatedGradientRow).
prototype: undefined __cdecl Lightmap_ComposeShadedMips(int * block, int width, int tileIndex)

name: Lightmap_ComposePlainMips
comment: Composites the tile's source texture blocks into the lightmap texel buffer at the selected mip level by copying texels without per-vertex light modulation, calling the mip downsampler for coarser levels.
prototype: undefined __cdecl Lightmap_ComposePlainMips(int * block, int width, int tileIndex)

name: Lightmap_EnsureTileResident
comment: Selects the appropriate lightmap mip level from the camera-distance budget, unlinks any stale block, allocates texture-cache storage, and dispatches to the shaded or plain mip composer to (re)build the tile lightmap, returning whether it was built at full resolution.
prototype: bool __cdecl Lightmap_EnsureTileResident(int baseLevel, int detailLevel, int tileIndex)

name: Lightmap_ReleaseBlockRef
comment: Decrements the reference count of a lightmap block and, when it reaches zero, returns the block to the free pool (DAT_0067d8f0) and marks it as freed.

name: Tex_SetObjectTileDetailLevel
comment: Raises an object's tile-grid texture detail to the requested mip level (clamped to 7), bumping per-tile mip reference counts and queuing load requests, then commits via Tex_CommitMipLevelChange; falls back to Tex_ReleaseToBaseMip when the level is zero.

name: Tex_ResolveOrAllocNodeTexture
comment: Returns the existing tile-grid texture id when high-detail streaming is enabled and the node is ready, otherwise allocates a fresh texture entry, initializes its mip-level fields and flags, registers it in the texture-object table, and returns its id.

name: Tex_RunCallbackAndReapplyDetail
comment: Invokes the object's stored completion callback (function pointer at +0x20 with argument at +0x24) if present, then re-runs Tex_SetObjectTileDetailLevel to reapply the texture detail level.

name: Tex_ReleaseToBaseMip
comment: Frees the texture's high-detail cache block back to the texture cache, reloads it at the base mip level, resets its mip-level fields and flag bits, fills it with the object's solid base color, and notifies the renderer via the device vtable.

name: Tex_ProcessDeferredMipUpdates
comment: Walks the deferred texture-update list, restoring the active texture globals and calling Tex_CommitMipLevelChange for each queued node before freeing it, then publishes the new free-block watermark.

name: Tex_InitObjectTable
comment: Initializes the texture subsystem by pointing four dispatch slots at a default handler, zeroing the 32000-entry texture-object pointer table, and installing the five per-state mip dispatch function pointers.

name: Tex_BuildProceduralMipPalette
comment: Rebuilds a texture's procedural mip palette, choosing the colored or the intensity-ramp generator based on a global mode flag, then copies the resulting max mip level into the current and base mip fields.

name: Tex_NullMipHandler
comment: Empty no-op texture mip handler used as a default/placeholder dispatch slot.

name: Tex_CompleteMipLoad
comment: Completes a queued texture mip-up load by allocating a larger cache block, copying the texel data into it, unlinking the old block, compositing any tagged overlay, downsampling, decrementing the pending-load counters, and firing the chained completion callback.

name: Tex_RequestMipLevel
comment: Requests raising a texture to the given mip level by allocating a load-request node and queuing per-child-tile load requests, installing a completion callback and bumping the pending counters, or completing immediately when nothing needs loading; downsamples in place when the requested level is below the current minimum.

name: TagMap_ReturnZeroStub
comment: Stub virtual method that always returns 0 (false).

name: TagMap_ClearTagToSlotMap
comment: Zeroes the entire 32000-entry global texture-tag-to-slot lookup table at DAT_0064f718.

name: TagMap_CreateTaggedTextureSlot
comment: Allocates a texture entry sized to the source surface, initializes its header fields, reserves space in the upload buffer, registers it in the tag-to-slot map, and composites and downsamples it into the tagged atlas.

name: TagMap_ReleaseTaggedTextures
comment: Walks the active tagged-texture list decrementing per-slot reference counts and freeing slots whose count reaches zero, then frees the pending deferred-free buffer.

name: TagMap_PromoteHottestTextures
comment: Builds a per-tag usage histogram across the given entity list and greedily promotes the most-referenced textures to their full mip level until the budget of 0x24 slots is exhausted.

name: Thermo_SetWrapEnabled
comment: Sets the Thermo widget's wrap-around flag (this+0x35) to 1, enabling value wrapping at the ends of its range.

name: Thermo_ClearWrapEnabled
